speaker: Commenter A
text: This plant will bring jobs and our kids can stay home. Love it.

speaker: Commenter B
text: They kept this secret for months. We are owed answers.

speaker: Commenter C
text: Good for the economy but we were never consulted and it feels rushed.

speaker: Commenter D
text: Who pays if costs overrun? Ratepayers should not carry that risk.

speaker: Commenter E
text: Flooding on the Marlow is bad enough, now they want to build in the floodplain?

speaker: Commenter F
text: Best thing to happen to this town in my lifetime.
